qualifying.status: construction (LNG trains suspended by client since mid-2013 under sanctions); dedicated power plant completed and grid-connected unit-by-unit since ~2022
qualifying.hardware_type: Dedicated on-site CCGT power station purpose-built for the Iran LNG project's own use (project Package I-C, 'E-LNG': Power Station, Electric Motors and Compressors), comprising 5 gas turbine units and 2 steam turbine units, aggregate 1,130 MW nameplate. Also carries 4 dedicated 3.3 MVA diesel gensets for emergency backup (diesel-only, not counted toward the fuel gate).
qualifying.individual_mw: 162 MW each (5 gas turbine units) and 160 MW each (2 steam turbine units), per project design table
qualifying.aggregate_mw: 1,130 MW aggregate nameplate (not required to qualify; individual units already clear threshold)
qualifying.basis: Individual >=50 MW (heavy-duty CCGT units, 162 MW/160 MW each). As-designed captive power counts per SOP even though the LNG trains themselves never started up and the completed power units have since been connected to Iran's national grid.

qualifying.status: operating (power-generation plant and mechanical-drive compression trains); proposed (per GEM status list)
qualifying.hardware_type: Mixed site. (1) On-site power-generation plant: originally 4x GE Frame 6 gas turbine-generators (120 MW total), replaced circa 2018-2020 by nine MAN 51/60 reciprocating gas engines rated 120 MW total, supplying electricity to the LNG facility. (2) Separate mechanical-drive gas turbines run the compressor trains: a 280 MW GE Frame 7 gas turbine drives the mixed-refrigerant compression train and a 42 MW GE Frame 6 gas turbine drives the propane compression train (Train 3/debottlenecking expansion).
qualifying.individual_mw: 280 MW (GE Frame 7, mechanical drive, MR train) qualifies individually; 42 MW (GE Frame 6, mechanical drive, propane train) is below the individual threshold; MAN gas-engine units are ~13 MW each (120 MW / 9 units), below the individual threshold
qualifying.aggregate_mw: 120 MW aggregate for the on-site MAN gas-engine power plant (genset rule applies to reciprocating gas engines) qualifies on its own
qualifying.basis: Qualifies both ways: Individual >=50 MW (mechanical drive, 280 MW GE Frame 7) AND Aggregate >=50 MW (genset rule, 120 MW MAN gas-engine power plant, both the legacy Frame 6 and current MAN configurations).

qualifying.hardware_type: Heavy-frame gas turbines mechanically shaft-drive the refrigeration compressor strings across this entity's Ras Laffan trains (Qatargas-heritage side): GE Frame 9E turbines (~132 MW ISO rating, documented) on the Qatargas II mega-trains via a Siemens VFD/Ansaldo motor-generator system that can also export surplus electrical power to the plant grid; GE Frame 5C/5D turbines on the earlier trains drive the mixed-refrigerant and propane refrigeration cycles.
qualifying.individual_mw: ~132 MW ISO each (GE Frame 9E, documented rating in source) qualifies individually; Frame 5C/5D units have no site-specific figure published (class rating ~25-32 MW, below threshold if inferred)
qualifying.aggregate_mw: n/a (mechanical drive, heavy-duty single units, not summed)
qualifying.basis: Individual >=50 MW (mechanical drive, GE Frame 9E ~132 MW ISO documented rating on the Qatargas II mega-trains).

qualifying.hardware_type: Heavy-frame gas turbines mechanically shaft-drive the refrigeration compressor strings on this entity's Ras Laffan trains (RasGas-heritage side): two GE Frame 7EA turbines (DLN-retrofitted 2011) drive the mixed-refrigerant and propane compressor trains on the earlier trains, and GE Frame 9E turbines (~132 MW ISO class) drive the Train 6-7 mega-trains, described by the turbine vendor as 'the world's largest mechanical-drive application.'
qualifying.individual_mw: ~132 MW ISO each (GE Frame 9E, documented rating in source) qualifies individually; ~85-90 MW each (GE Frame 7EA; Frame 7 class rating inference, no site-specific figure published) also qualifies individually

qualifying.basis: Individual >=50 MW (mechanical drive; Frame 9E ~132 MW ISO documented + Frame 7EA ~85-90 MW class-rating inference, both named turbine models).
